dedupe_keys.name: high resolution global building height map gbhm 10 m developed based on sentinel imagery

description: A Chinese remote-sensing team publishes global building-height estimates on ten-metre raster tiles. Zenodo lists ninety-two files, mainly longitude-banded RAR archives, under CC BY 4.0. The page explains a scale factor of one hundred: a stored pixel value of 1500 corresponds to fifteen metres. The describing study compares this product with other height datasets and examines inequality in building infrastructure. These tiles can supply building-volume and exposure proxies for urban heat, energy and hazard simulations. Related catalogue data-3d-globfp-global-3d-building-footprints instead provides estimated heights attached to building footprints. Coverage is the mapped global grid, not field measurements of each structure. A limitation is that the page does not report local error distributions or how missing and non-building pixels are encoded in the archives. The scaling rule must be applied before analysis. No raster archive was downloaded or spatial accuracy reproduced.
